headline: Am I destined to be alone, or has it just not happened yet?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/drafts/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing LONELINESS_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. The picture was hidden, but your hand found the card where nothing has been put away.
Every tool remains laid out on the open table.
You asked whether you are destined to be alone or love has simply not happened. The open table is the part I notice first.
Love has not happened, and destiny is the explanation pressing on the question.
Whatever is keeping connection away leaves the possibilities open. I don't think this began with you.
Let me see what is holding this…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. You chose without seeing him and found the one that's still growing.
Green leaves grow from the wood above the paused figure.
You asked whether the pause is destiny. This card brings me to the living growth inside it.
Still, you are alone, and the pause feels larger than a pause now.
Right where the pause would open into connection, something appears. I don't think it started with you.
Let me see what's holding this…
c: You turned the Fool. The cards were face down, yet you reached for the one in full light.
The full sun is high behind him.
You asked whether the road is fated or only unfinished. The full light on the card catches me.
But no one has joined the road, and the unknown has begun to feel decided.
Something sits between the open beginning and the relationship. I don't think it began with you.
Now let's look at what's there…
